entities.name: village stall shed (thatched hip roof, open front)
entities.what: The long shed of the village tea-and-food stall where the canal market begins: a big thatched hip roof (hatched straw strokes; the front eave a dashed row of thatch ends) on posts, the front open. At its west end customers sit at a table under the eave (the lower roof S1.bld.stall_annex_29350); between the posts at u 29486-29599 a board or lattice fascia hangs under the eave; east of it the front under the eave is blank silk (no wall drawn: open, or a pale plastered wall). A second, smaller thatched roof stands behind its east end (S1.bld.stall_back_shed_29860).
entities.vis: part: west half behind the willow trunks over the stall, roof under willow branches; back hidden
entities.src: sections.md S1: the village tea and food stalls at the edge of the market
entities.note: THATCH, not tile: the roof is filled with hatched straw strokes and its eave is a row of short hanging thatch ends at v 539-550 from u 29374 to 29825 (the restyle draws blue tile: wrong). ROOF (zoom 2, raised contrast): the ridge is a line at v 420 running west from 29675 (its west end lost in the willow branches); the east end is a HIP: a line from the ridge end (29675,420) down to the front eave's east corner (29825,548) (slope +0.85, a hip line, not a receding edge). FRONT: one post read clearly at u 29486 (v 551-664); the fascia board 29486-29599 at v 551-570; the east end edge drops from (29805,550) to (29820,620). Ground line: the post foot (29486,664) and t1's counter S1.prop.stall_counter_29430 (feet v 664-666); the other bays and the sw/se corners are est on that line. DEPTH: not painted; the back corners are placeholders 62 px of v behind the front (about 1.2 m at 51.25 px/m: the builder settles the depth as choice:). The long horizontal line at v 361-367 (u 29599-29705) above the roof is a far field bank (S1.grd.terraced_fields_29450 edge_v362), not the ridge. SCALE CUES: front eave about 120 px over the ground (eave v 545, ground v 665); fascia 113 px long; eave run 451 px (29374-29825); ridge 128 px above the eave. SECOND PASS (west): the slats over the counter (u 29437-29490, v 553-597) are this shed's lattice front running on west of the post at u 29486 (vertical slats from the eave to the counter's top, the same as the fascia lattice at 29486-29599, v 551-570); a few dark knots among them at v 565-590 (u 29445-29480) may be small goods on the counter. No entity (as the merge decided); build the lattice from 29437.

entities.name: tiled farmhouse hall with a veranda

East of u 30120 its front is hidden by the front wing's roof (S1.bld.farmhouse_wing_30190; the two belong together), and its east end by the willow crown at about 30330.

entities.name: the country road from the market through the village, under the great willows and past the farmsteads to the charcoal train's path
entities.what: The walk through S1's west half, read from the open, trodden ground (no road is drawn in the countryside): from the market seam it runs east across the village ground in front of the stall shed (where the buffalo, the ox and the barrow are), over the open field where the runaway horse and its chasers run, then turns south between the farmhouse and the hut under a willow's hanging branches, down to the travellers' band of ground, runs east along the willow dyke (隋堤) among the great pollarded willows, and climbs north-east behind the massive willows toward the farmhouses' road. East of u 33000 (structures_e's join piece, spliced in the merge): The country road along the front of the farmsteads: a level strip of bare earth between the farmhouses' fences and the bank in front of them, past the open barn and along the south of the threshing floor, then north of the big bare trees and down the charcoal donkey train's path, which runs diagonally from the train's head (north-west) to its driver (south-east) on a low bank above the stream, and on east along the north bank until the seal and the mist take it. No road edge is drawn anywhere: the edges are where the trodden ground meets fence, bank or open ground.
entities.vis: part: the ground is ink wash and no edge is drawn anywhere; under the big willows' crowns at u 32300-33300; behind the big bare trees at u 35800-36150; under a seal from u ~37250
entities.src: 余辉: 隋堤烟柳 (setting); 惊马闯市 (setting)
entities.note: POINT 0 = the datum, copied from S2.road.main's last centre point in gen/map/S2/parts/structures_w.json: (29050,730) est, with S2's edges there (edge_n 695, edge_s 1000) - the open ground in front of the 望楼饭铺 shed's east end and S1's stall. The EAST END (32850, 33000, 33150) copies structures_e's join piece S1.road.main_east point for point (centre 1000/985/965, edge_n 960/945/925, edge_s 1040/1025/1005), so the splice at 33000 is clean. EDGES, how read: west stretch (29050-30450) edge_n = the stall's front line (post foot v 664; t1's counter S1.prop.stall_counter_29430 at v 664-666) and the foot of the chase field's north bank (S1.grd.bank_30300); edge_s = under the bottom-left willow's crown (the walker at 29200 has his feet at about v 1060), the 菜地's north edge (S1.grd.field_vegetable_29790) and the farmhouse hall's back (placeholder). The turn south (30400-30720) is NOT painted as a path: it is the 300 px gap of open ground under hanging willow branches between the farmhouse (east end about 30400) and the hut's fence (west end 30712); all its points est. Lower stretch (30720-32300): edge_n = the hut fence's foot, the foot of S1.grd.bank_30750 and the willow dyke's front bank (S1.grd.bank_31660); edge_s = the tops of the next banks down (S1.grd.bank_30900, S1.grd.bank_31680). It passes south of the willows at 31548-31939 and north of the massive willow's trunk foot at about 32080 (hidden behind it). The CLIMB (32300-32850) to structures_e's road in front of the farmhouses (v about 920 at 33450) is not painted: it runs behind (north of) the massive trunk at 32470-32780, crossing S1.grd.bank_32445 and S1.grd.bank_32900; all est. OTHER READINGS of the route: (a) an upper way behind the hut and the great willows at v about 850-1000 (the willows' crowns hide that ground; it would skip the willows' feet, 隋堤烟柳's view); (b) the travellers' path (S1.road.path_30300) reached from the village ground through the 54 px gap between the 菜地's east end and the farmhouse wing (u 30002-30056, v 1130-1300): too narrow for a road; (c) under the bottom-left willow past the walker at 29200: nothing drawn. The sedan party's track (S1.road.path_30950) leaves the silk at its top and cannot carry the route east. MERGE: spliced at u 33000 with structures_e's join piece S1.road.main_east (dropped): points up to and including u 33000 are structures_w's, points east of it the piece's (identical at 32850/33000/33150, so the splice is clean). The east piece's own reading follows. HOW READ. u 33400-35250 (conf med): edge_n = the feet of the brushwood fences and hedges (v 882-918) and the barn's posts (v 867-880); edge_s = the top of the yard bank S1.grd.yard_bank_34400 (v 945-966; 925-935 at the threshing floor). u 36190-36900 (conf med): the centre is the line of the donkey train's hooves and drivers' feet (t8: head driver ~(36245, 766), donkeys at v 798, 830-841, 880-885, 903-917, 936-946, rear driver (36795, 925)); edge_s = the top of the dyke bank S1.grd.dyke_36380 under them; edge_n is est, ~50 px north of the centre. u 35250-36190: not painted as a path; est, joining the threshing floor to the train's head behind (north of) the big bare trees whose bases are at v ~1100-1230. u 32850-33300: under the willow crown, est; structures_w's reading of S1.road.main at u 33000-33150 decides, and the merge reconciles the overlap. East of the rear driver nothing marks it: it is est, bent to pass south of the roots of the bare tree with the leaning pole (t8, roots u 37030-37180, v 880-955) and north of the north bank's top. East end (37240, 975) est: from u 37250 a seal covers the strip (v 800-980) and beyond it is plain silk (mist), so nothing past it is recorded. WHY THIS IS THE MAIN ROAD: the charcoal donkey train, the painting's travellers here, walks it toward the city, and it is the only continuous level strip through the farmsteads; the bridge path S1.road.path_36380 has no readable continuation off the bridge. Width 40-80 px of v (about 1-1.5 m at 51.25 px/m). MERGE (for the frame and the builder): between u 35030 and 35420 the route's centre (v 905-895) and edge_n (v 860-845) run inside the south part of S1.grd.threshing_floor_35225 (v 800-930): the road skirts the floor along its south edge, and the two share that strip of open ground; nothing is painted to separate them. The two unpainted bends (30400-30720 south, 32300-32850 north) and the est stretch 35250-36190 are recorded choices of reading, not strokes. SECOND PASS (start): the note says 'from u 37250 a seal covers the strip (v 800-980)'. Measured, the seal at that height spans u 37396-37538, v 805-1007. The seal starting at 37248 is the top one (v 51-319). Between 37250 and 37396 the strip is painted open ground: the bank's foot (S1.grd.bank_37050, v 962-978) above it and the north bank's top (S1.grd.bank_36900, v ~1045-1060) below it. The est route can run on to the seal's edge, ending at 37390. That is OPTIONAL: it is still a reading through unpainted ground, and it adds about 2 m to the walkable east end. FRAME: point 0 of each line is S2.road.main's last point at u 29050, copied from map/strokes/S2.json on every run of merge_fixes.mjs (centre (29050, 730) measured by S2, edges (29050, 695) and (29050, 1000) est): the datum of map/frames/S1.json, station +314.87. FRAME: edge_n gets two points at the hut willow's bole, (31150, 1500, est) and (31250, 1500, est), between (31100, 1484) and (31300, 1470, est): with the bole's base moved to its drawn lower edge (31215, 1492, est; second pass willows) the old line ran about 20 px inside the bole. The centre (31150, 1530, est) is unchanged. FRAME (from the second pass farms, for the lead): from u 33400 to 34750 nine tree bases stand between edge_n and edge_s, five on or south of the centre (S1.tree.elm_forked_33433, elm_forked_33785, elm_tall_33865, elm_slender_33906, elm_twin_33936, elm_spreading_34030, bare_elm_twin_34552, bare_elm_twin_34640, bare_elm_tall_34703): the light strip between the fences' feet (v ~895-918) and the yard bank's top (v ~943-950) is the only level ground there, and the trees stand on it. The lines are kept as read (the strokes don't settle it): the walkable line weaves between the trunks (a build choice), or the lead moves the centre onto the bank top just south of the feet (v ~945-950).

entities.vis: part: east of 29870 under the willow crowns; v 300-360 behind the stall's willows
entities.note: Read at zoom 1-2 with raised contrast. Each edge_* line is one field bank or ridge, named by its v. Which side is higher is not drawn; read as fields stepping up to the north (up the silk), each step a few px (far: the figures standing on edge_v155's strip are 32-47 px tall, so a low bank there is about 5-10 px). BOTH READINGS: terraced fields (the restyle draws stone-faced terraces) or flat fields with raised ridges between them; the strokes give only the lines. The lines continue west of the seam to about 28950 (edge_v57 at (28960,58), edge_v155 at (28950,148)): S2's ground. diag_ne (29740,30)->(29850,130) is a second diagonal line parallel to the path, perhaps the fields' east boundary. MERGE (cross-key seam check against map/strokes/S2.json, u 28750-29350): edge_v155 starts at (29050, 152), 2 px from S2.grd.bank_lines_top_28900's edge_n end (29050, 150): the same stroke, already trimmed at the seam on both sides. EXTENDED east past the silk crease at u ~29845: edge_v85 to (30060, 88) (depth 13-21 at u 29860-30010) and edge_v120 to (30060, 112) (weaker, depth 8-11). MOVED: edge_v185 -> edge_v177 (no stroke on the old line, 147 against 142-150; the stroke is at v 176-177, 140 against 148) and edge_v265 -> edge_v282 (no stroke on the old line: 140 against 133-142; the stroke is at v 279-286 from u 29560 to 29830, depth 21-30, broken where S1.road.path_29640 crosses it at u 29620-29690). Both moved lines lie partly under willow shoots (S1.tree.willow_stall_c_29300, S1.tree.willow_east_29845); the profiles were read in bands on both sides of the shoots. Not changed: edge_v57 (its stroke is faint; the darkest rows at 29050-29150 are v 43-48 and 67-69, both weak), edge_v300 (no clear stroke on it or 18 px below; shoots), edge_v152 and edge_v215 (within 5 px). The far figures stand on these strips: the pair at v 118-122 on the strip between edge_v95w and edge_v128w; S1.fig.far_figure_29337 (v 141) and the group at v 143-145 on the strip between edge_v128w's line and edge_v155. FRAME (cross-key seam check): edge_v155's first point takes S2.grd.bank_lines_top_28900 edge_n's last point exactly, (29050, 150) (was (29050, 152)), so the line joins across the seam; copied from map/strokes/S2.json on every run.

entities.name: the vegetable field (菜地)
entities.what: A slightly raised plot south of the village ground, west of the farmhouse, planted with young bare trees: 13 trunk feet and a faint fourteenth, each its own tree entity (S1.tree.young_bare_29558 to S1.tree.young_bare_29968), whose low crab-claw crowns fill the plot (the second pass counted the feet; "25-35 small plants" was a reading of these crowns); a pale pointed rock (S1.grd.rock_29745) stands at its north-west corner.
entities.vis: part: plants overlap the edges; west end under the bottom-left willow's branches
entities.note: North edge v 1116-1130 from the rock (29790) to 30000 (zoom 1.6); south edge = the top of the bank S1.grd.bank_29750 (v 1330-1350); west end at about 29550-29600 where the plants start; east end at the farmhouse wing (30000-30056). ROWS: the plants stand in loose bands at about v 1140-1200, 1200-1280 and 1280-1350, running roughly along the scroll (dv/du about 0); no furrow or row line is drawn, so the field gives NO receding edge for the frame. The plants are painted as tiny bare shrubs (the restyle too): vegetables (pin 5 名画记: 菜地) or a nursery of saplings. t1 records the taller ones as 13 young bare trees (S1.tree.young_bare_29558 ... S1.tree.young_bare_29948, bases v 1222-1400): this entity is the plot's ground only, never a second record of its plants; whether they are a crop or a grove is the merge's and the user's call (BOTH READINGS). t1's post S1.prop.post_crossbar_29862 stands at its north edge. MERGE: the plants are counted two ways: t1 records 13 young bare trees with trunks 90-180 px tall (S1.tree.young_bare_29558 ... _29948, count good to about +-2); this entity's what describes 25-35 small twiggy plants 30-70 px tall in 3-4 loose bands. On the merge's zoom-1.6 crop the plot is a dense mass of small bare crab-claw crowns over thin trunks (v 1150-1350), the trunks clearer in its east half. SECOND PASS (west): trunk feet counted on column darkness profiles (red channel, 20 px bands of v from 1180 to 1380): 13 trunks, the same as t1's trees (u 29558, 29647-29661, 29733-29738, 29746-29756, 29780, 29794-29796, 29837, 29860-29862, 29879-29885, 29899-29905, 29915-29920, 29933, 29950), plus a faint fourteenth at 29966-29975 (proposed, S1.tree.young_bare_29968, low). Between them the profiles show no further stems with feet: the '25-35 small plants' are these trees' low crab-claw crowns and branches (the middle group's trees are only 90-170 px tall, so their crowns fill the band v 1250-1350). The planting to build is the 13 (or 14) trees; crop or grove of saplings stays the user's call.

MERGE: t1 recorded the same mass as the prop S1.prop.rock_or_heap_29745 (rock, earth mound or straw heap; its west face's hatching "like rock texture more than straw"); that prop is retired and this entity kept. On the merge's zoom 2.5-4 crops it reads as an upright pointed rock: the shaded west face is laid in with diagonal texture strokes, and no head, face, hands or feet are drawn. SECOND PASS (west): a rock; reading (b) is dropped. At zoom 2-3 the west face is laid in with short parallel diagonal texture strokes (rock texture), the outline rises to a pointed, slightly west-leaning summit at (29757, 1043) and runs down into the field's ground with no hem, feet or hands, and no face or hood opening is drawn. As a figure it would stand 104 px from summit to foot (v 1043-1147) beside the 146 px man at the post at the same foot level: too short for a standing adult. The restyle's man in blue here is invented.
